entries.dialogueText: They were representing Sordland in the international arena. I couldn't help but feel a surge of pride as Lucian and I headed to the stadium.

entries.title: Narrator: "Millions of Sordish people were wai..."
entries.dialogueText: Millions of Sordish people were waiting to watch FC Anrica compete against the legendary Rizian team Real Montaklar. Despite all odds being stacked against the team, the mood was full of hope.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A win today would bring Anrica to t..."
entries.dialogueText: A win today would bring Anrica to the quarter finals, a feat that no Sordish team had ever managed to achieve.

entries.title: Narrator: "Another group of fans raised their..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The stadium erupted in applause as..."

entries.title: Narrator: "Right after the referee signalled t..."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
